company.name: Candid Health
company.shortDescription: Candid Health offers healthcare revenue cycle software that automates billing processes.
company.description: Candid Health develops software that supports healthcare organizations in managing revenue cycle operations. Its platform automates and coordinates processes such as medical coding, claims submission, payment posting, denial management, and reimbursement workflows. The company integrates with electronic health record and practice management systems to facilitate the exchange of clinical and billing data across healthcare providers and payers. It provides tools that enable healthcare organizations to monitor billing performance, identify claim issues, and manage revenue cycle activities through a centralized system. The company also offers analytics and workflow capabilities that support administrative and financial operations within healthcare practices.

productsAndServices.description: A software platform that automates healthcare revenue cycle management by processing medical claims and related billing information for healthcare providers.
